name: Russula cyanoxantha
notes: Stands for the largest ectomycorrhizal genus. The survey codes it ECM-M/ECM-S: the genus is listed as medium-distance smooth [13], but many Russula are reported (unchecked) to be contact type, and research/02 lists the genus under contact.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): Russulas grow very slowly in culture

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
